summary: Corrected truncation, damage, and event semantics kept the controller and critic healthy but did not produce Zone 2 progress. The 61,440-transition checkpoint was the strongest point on the curve, reaching Floor 2 on four distinct unseen seeds across the three policy modes, with seed 60009 repeating in all modes; no checkpoint reached Floor 3 or Zone 2. Continued PPO updates degraded action efficiency: the 122,880 deterministic checkpoint had 75% step limits and 84.97% unchanged-position turns, while the final deterministic checkpoint had no Floor 2 exits, 54.17% step limits, and 85.97% unchanged-position turns. Live outcomes repeatedly showed thousands of wall attempts in unchanged states. Reject corrections alone as the Zone 2 solution; retain the historical A2/V2 baseline and test stateful known-invalid wall masking before curriculum or further reward/architecture changes.
